Grid Mapper uses an optional, separately installed NDI Runtime through its C ABI.
No NDI runtime binary or NDI Tool is included in this distribution.
NDI information, tools and runtime: https://ndi.video/
NDI SDK terms and distribution guidance:
https://docs.ndi.video/all/developing-with-ndi/sdk/licensing
https://docs.ndi.video/all/developing-with-ndi/sdk/software-distribution

and Processing.NDI.structs.h). The header-only license is reproduced below;
it does not license the separately installed runtime or SDK as a whole.
